quote: That living word awakened my soul, gave it light, hope, joy, set it free!
source: Helen Keller, The Story of My Life, chapter IV, the well-house (Doubleday, Page and Company, 1903)

evidence.where: Project Gutenberg text of The Story of My Life (ebook 2397), chapter IV, read directly
evidence.edition: The Story of My Life, Doubleday, Page and Company, New York, 1903
evidence.locator: chapter IV, the paragraph after the teacher spells water into her hand at the well-house

reason: The sentence stands word for word in chapter IV of the Gutenberg text of the 1903 book. The proposal's locator said the water pump at Tuscumbia; Keller writes of the well-house, so the locator is given in her word. Keller has no line this year, and the moment of the word water is the sentence the book is known by.
